csv_project_name: Engineering Service for Center Park Improvements Phase I
csv_scope_of_work: To provide engineering, design, grant administration and related services for a project to upgrade facilities at Center Park, 240 Long Bay Drive, Springfield, Illinois 62712This project would take place at Center Park on the shoreline and marginal lands of Lake Springfield. The proposed project includes the following: New pickleball courts, a new playground with high quality surfacing, parking lot improvements, a new fence to seal the park in from the parallel arterial road, and a new walking path to tie all the new features together that will provide a path from the parking lot to the pickleball courts, playground, shoreline, and dock.
